convention.peaks: Retain all exact passes. Label positive minimum orb as closest approach. A clipped edge is not an extremum; a nonunique minimum is not assigned an arbitrary instant.

convention.constantAndNonunique: Analytic fixtures cover longitude identically at target: one full-query clipped component with an exact plateau range and no arbitrary finite list of passes; identically target+3 or target-3: full-query threshold plateau, positive duration, both ends clipped, no exact pass. A positive constant orb has a nonunique minimum range. Nonunique minima never get an arbitrary timestamp or zero-duration ICS.
convention.uncertainTopology: A numerical root bracket is an interval, not proof of equality with a neighboring root. Distinct branch/level identities with overlapping or unordered refined brackets are unresolved topology; fail or retain an explicit unresolved result, never merge by 100ms/1minute/season gaps or synthesize a tangent.

Require it wholly within the component/full query and free of another extremum or exact pass; retain all local minima and distinguish the component global minimum. For C the level is computed from acquired e_min + 0.10 degrees, never hardcoded 1.6 degrees. The 2B argument assumes uniform function error within the component; passing finite fixtures does not prove that assumption globally.
gates.minimumEnvelopeFailure: If either envelope side cannot be bracketed or another extremum/query/component edge lies inside it, preserve the receipt as ill-conditioned and stop for root review. Do not turn a clipped edge into a minimum or replace the envelope with an observed app residual.
gates.singletonAndPlateauPolicy: Analytic fixtures cover longitude identically at target: one full-query clipped component with an exact plateau range and no arbitrary finite list of passes; identically target+3 or target-3: full-query threshold plateau, positive duration, both ends clipped, no exact pass. A positive constant orb has a nonunique minimum range. Nonunique minima never get an arbitrary timestamp or zero-duration ICS. A numerical root bracket is an interval, not proof of equality with a neighboring root. Distinct branch/level identities with overlapping or unordered refined brackets are unresolved topology; fail or retain an explicit unresolved result, never merge by 100ms/1minute/season gaps or synthesize a tangent. Cross-model geometry within B of threshold/exact levels is intentionally ill-conditioned, so analytic singleton/plateau tests must not be inferred from this external pack.
